thread:
Morgan: Heads-up — BrightLog (customer) on Dedicated hit a surge at 16:02 UTC and autoscaler didn’t bring up extra replicas fast enough, app saw 503/latency spikes. Support ticket BR-4521.
Alex: Can you paste the logs / repro? We only saw a few pulses in telemetry.
Morgan: Repro steps from Support:
- Send 200 rps for 3s, then 800 rps sustained for 40s
- Observed queued requests and 50% 503s for ~45s
Support-Bot: Attached logs -> /support/BR-4521/attach.log (snippet below)

Support-Bot: ```
2026-01-04T16:02:03Z INFO autoscaler: evaluate: target_rps=720 current_replicas=2 calculated_needed=6
2026-01-04T16:02:04Z WARN provision: start_attach request_id=xyz latency=4s
2026-01-04T16:02:12Z ERROR probe: timeout for probe_id=abc status=unready
2026-01-04T16:02:30Z INFO autoscaler: scaled_to=3 reason=min_replicas_hit=false
``` 

Jamal: Looks like probe timeouts + attach latencies caused the autoscaler to be conservative. Also seeing min_replicas=2 and max_replicas=10 in customer config.
Sasha: Any noisy neighbor indications? GPU utilization on node pool during the spike?
Morgan: Node telemetry shows one VM with high disk IO and OOM events earlier in hour — could be noisy tenant. But most attach pods queued on kube-scheduler for ~8s.
Alex: Important detail: autoscaler has an attach_holdoff=12s in this cluster (custom policy). That combined with probe timeouts mean new pods took 20-30s before being counted.
Jamal: Proposed quick workaround for customer: temporarily bump min_replicas to 4 OR enable reserved burst capacity (if on Dedicated plan) so headroom avoids 503s during short spikes.
Sasha: For platform fix: reduce attach_holdoff default to 6s for burst-oriented pools; add a faster health-probe path for warmup so autoscaler can count pods earlier.
Morgan: Assigned to eng-platform to triage noisy-node signals and to eng-runtime for probe tuning. Also telling Support to offer workaround.
Alex: Quick test plan to reproduce in staging:
1) Set min_replicas=2, attach_holdoff=12s
2) Run the RPS pattern above
3) Capture attach timings, probe durations, and autoscaler decisions
4) Retest with min_replicas=4 and attach_holdoff=6s
Jamal: I'm on it — will run a controlled replay against staging cluster-ux-3 and paste timelines.
OpsBot: Alert: cluster-ux-3 node pool kube-scheduler latency spike at 2026-01-04T16:01:52Z
Morgan: Thanks — once Jamal posts timings, we can propose a permanent change to the default burst policy and an RFC for an autoscale fast-path when latency > X.
Support-Bot: Customer update sent: "We're applying a temporary min_replicas increase and monitoring; eng is investigating a permanent fix." :thumbsup:
Sasha: Also let's check billing/quotas — sometimes imagePull backoff due to rate limit looks like slow scaleup. In this case image pulls succeeded though.
Alex: Follow-ups: Jamal to post repro logs, eng-platform to propose config patch, and oncall to monitor BrightLog for 2 hours after workaround. Tagging @eng-platform and @eng-runtime.
Morgan: Thanks team. If anyone wants to pair on the staging repro ping me in thread.
